## Purpose
Explain what changes and how it improves the model or website.

## Model and evidence
- [ ] Governing equations, units and system boundary checked
- [ ] Supporting citations and data provenance included
- [ ] Unverified assumptions clearly labeled
- [ ] No measured validation claimed without actual data

## Quality
- [ ] Python 3.13 tests pass
- [ ] Streamlit page starts without exception
- [ ] UI usable on mobile and keyboard where relevant
- [ ] No secrets or personal data committed
- [ ] CHANGELOG/README updated as needed

## Academic conduct
Authorized AI assistance, attribution and source reuse are disclosed where required.
